auth.lockHint: After 5 wrong passwords, signing in is locked for 15 minutes.
auth.registerLead: Every new account gets a {days}-day trial with all features. No card and no automatic payment.
auth.name: Name
auth.termsLabel: I accept the {terms}. How my data is kept is described in the {privacy}.
auth.checkEmailText: We sent an email to {email}. Open the link in it to confirm the address and start your trial.
auth.checkEmailHint: No email? Check your spam folder. The link is valid for {hours}.
auth.verifiedText: Your trial has started. Sign in and create your first project.
auth.emailChangedText: From now on you sign in with the new address.
auth.verifyFailedText: The link has expired or was already used. Sign in and request a new one from your account.
auth.forgotText: Enter your email and we will send you a link to set a new password.
auth.forgotSent: If there is an account with this email, we sent a link to set a new password. It is valid for {hours}.
auth.setPasswordText: The email is yours — only the password is left. The link was opened on another device than the one used to sign up, so the password is set again: this way an account someone else created with your address does not stay in their hands. You can also enter the password you chose when signing up.
auth.twofaText: Enter the six-digit code from your authenticator app.
auth.twofaRecoveryHint: No phone at hand? Enter one of your recovery codes.
auth.bannedText: This account is blocked and cannot sign in.
auth.bannedContact: If you think this is a mistake, write to {email}.
auth.unverifiedWait: Your email is not confirmed yet. Open the link in the email we sent you.
auth.unverifiedResent: Your email is not confirmed yet. We sent you a new link.

errors.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.unverified: Your email is not confirmed yet.
errors.name: The name must be 2 to 80 characters, without links or email addresses.
errors.terms: Accept the terms of use to continue.
errors.mfaReset: Too many wrong codes. Sign in again.
errors.linkExpired: The link has expired or was already used.

password.rules: At least {passwordMin} characters. A phrase of several words is safer than a short password with symbols.
password.tooShort: The password is shorter than {passwordMin} characters.
password.tooLong: The password is longer than {passwordMax} characters.
password.common: This password is among the most used ones. Choose another.
password.personal: The password contains your name or email. Choose another.
password.repetitive: The password is too uniform: repeated characters or a sequence.
password.breached: This password has leaked in a breach of another website. Choose another.

security.title: Security
security.codesText: Save them now — you will not see them again. Each code signs you in once if you do not have your phone.
security.staffKeeps: Team accounts cannot turn off two-factor protection.
security.setupText: Scan the code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Aegis, 1Password) and enter the six-digit code it shows.
security.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
security.manualKey: Or enter the key by hand:
security.whyTwofa: With a second factor, the password alone is not enough to sign in: a code from your phone is needed too.
security.staffMust: Team accounts open the admin panel only with two-factor protection.
security.passwordOthers: After the change, all other sessions are signed out.
security.devicesHint: The devices used to sign in to this account. If you do not recognise one, change your password.

data.title: Data
data.exportText: Everything we keep about you — profile, projects, plan and orders, devices, sign-ins, sessions and the audit log entries about you — in one JSON file.
data.deleteText: The account and all its projects are deleted permanently. This cannot be undone — download what you need first.
data.deleteCheck: I understand that deletion is permanent.
data.deleteConfirm: Last check: delete the account and all its projects?
